title: Flutter Portfolio Premium
description: A premium Flutter web portfolio with dark mode and animations
longDescription: This project showcases a modern portfolio built with Flutter Web. Features include dark/light theme toggle, Lottie animations, responsive design, and GitHub API integration.

title: Next.js Premium Dashboard
description: Modern dashboard with Three.js background animations
longDescription: A sophisticated dashboard built with Next.js featuring Three.js 3D backgrounds, real-time data charts, and dark/light theme support.

title: Ktor Backend API
longDescription: A robust backend API built with Kotlin and Ktor. Features include JWT authentication, PostgreSQL integration, and comprehensive API documentation.
